name: Ruppertsberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ruppertsberg (a black tower with grapes on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Ruppertsberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ruppertsberg arms — black tower with grapes on yellow
